name: JetBrains Air
description: A new agentic desktop IDE from JetBrains designed specifically for managing and orchestrating multiple AI agents concurrently. Built on JetBrains' 26 years of development experience, Air supports Codex, Claude Agent, Gemini CLI, and Junie (JetBrains' own CLI) out of the box, with BYOK functionality.
community_quotes: Air launches as public preview - a new wave of dev tooling built on 26 years of experience
An agentic development environment designed for delegating coding tasks to multiple AI agents
Built on abandoned Fleet, JetBrains' previous collaborative IDE project
JetBrains launches AI agent IDE built on the corpse of abandoned Fleet

name: Junie CLI
description: JetBrains' LLM-agnostic coding agent CLI that brings JetBrains quality to any environment. Features real-time prompting, codebase intelligence, and can work autonomously or collaboratively with developers. Terminal-based with support for multiple language models.
community_quotes: Junie CLI, the LLM-agnostic coding agent, is now in Beta
Bring JetBrains quality to any environment
Terminal-based AI agent for autonomous or collaborative development
Works with multiple high-performance models, can be used in terminals, IDEs, CI/CD pipelines
